server_name.description: The server name as advertised to clients.

defer_ident.description: Defer IDENT lookups to improve performance. Set to true to skip unnecessary DNS lookups.

listen_port.description: The port on which the FTP server listens for connections.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients allowed.

host_rules.description: List of per-user allow/deny access rules.

user.description: Username to which this rule applies.

allow.description: If true, allow access; if false, deny access.

passive_ports.description: Port range for passive FTP data connections.

start.description: First port in the passive range.

end.description: Last port in the passive range.

enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for FTP control and data connections.

required.description: If true, require TLS for all sessions; otherwise allow plain FTP.

cert_file.description: Path to the server’s TLS certificate file.

key_file.description: Path to the server’s TLS private key file.

ca_file.description: Optional: Path to CA certificate for client verification.

mod_proxy.description: Enable and configure mod_proxy for proxying FTP requests to remote backends.

auth_methods.description: List of authentication methods supported for proxy connections (e.g., ['PAM', 'Shadow', 'LDAP']).

backends.description: List of backend servers to proxy FTP requests to.

protocol.description: Protocol used by the backend (ftp, http, or https).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend server.

port.description: Port number of the backend server.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the backend.

system_log.description: Path to the system (daemon) log file.

transfer_log.description: Path to the transfer (file upload/download) log file.
